snippet.title: KEMCO RPG Selection Vol. 4 for PS5 - Official Trailer for Asian countries
snippet.description:
KEMCO RPG Selection Vol. 4 for PS5®

Chronus Arc
Venture through puzzle-filled dungeons to bring the past back to the present!

Bonds of the Skies
A fantasy RPG with a story of friendship between humans and spirits!

Legend of the Tetrarchs
A fantasy RPG with turn-based battles and dungeons in beautiful pixel art!

Monochrome Order
Guide the world toward the right direction through Judgments in a fantasy RPG with multiple endings!

Specification
- Title: KEMCO RPG Selection Vol. 4
- Genre: Role Playing Game
- Release Date: 12/18/2025
- Platforms: PlayStation®5 - Physical Only
- Supported Languages: Japanese package version for Japan includes only Japanese. English package version for Asia includes only English.
- Supported Regions: Japan & Asia

*All images are subject to change in the actual product
